title: Commercial establishment processed with failure
description: Per-item failure outcome of a Tangara commercial establishment batch registration/update. One event is emitted per failed item to the commercial_establishment_processed_failure event type. The payload can carry b3RegisteredAt, the value of the request header b3-registered-at, when the header is sent.

key.title: Key
key.description: Client-provided identifier of the commercial establishment item within the batch

b3RegisteredAt.title: B3 registered at
b3RegisteredAt.description: Value of the header b3-registered-at, returned unchanged; omitted when the header is not sent

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: List of processing errors for the item

code.title: Error code
code.description: Business error code of the item. Examples: [090001=EC already exists] [090002=EC not found] [090003=invalid request] [090500=failed to persist the EC]. The list is not exhaustive: ce-api sends other codes.
